title: Before you ask, we've already answered.
subtitle: The questions that come up most on WhatsApp, organized by topic.
bottomLink: Didn't find your answer? Reach out on WhatsApp

categories.label: Quotes & timelines
categories.description: How the quote works and how long the build takes.

questions.question: How long does it take to build a setup?
questions.answer: It depends on parts availability, but a standard build ships in 2 to 4 business days after the quote is approved. For a project with custom water cooling or made-to-measure sleeved cables, the timeline is agreed separately.

questions.question: How does the quote work before I commit to a build?
questions.answer: You tell us what you need and we put together the quote part by part, no fixed package. Every swap is explained before any purchase.

categories.label: Build & parts
categories.description: Parts, compatibility, and how we build your setup.

questions.question: Do you build with parts I already own?
questions.answer: Yes, we make use of whatever still makes sense in your current setup and only suggest swapping what's truly worth it. No pushing new parts you don't need.

questions.question: Do I need to understand hardware before requesting a build?
questions.answer: No. You tell us the game you play or the software you run day to day, and we point you to the right parts for it.

questions.question: Can I pay the quote in installments?
questions.answer: Yes. We split payments by card and also accept a deposit plus an agreed remaining balance. The final amount and payment terms come together with the quote, no fine print.

questions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: Card, Pix, and cash. Installments and terms are agreed together with the quote.

categories.label: After-sales & support
categories.description: Warranty, service, and support after delivery.

questions.question: Do you offer a warranty on parts and labor?
questions.answer: Yes. New parts carry each manufacturer's factory warranty, and the build labor has All Frames' own warranty. Any issue after delivery, you talk directly to whoever built it. No outsourced support.

questions.question: Do I need to bring the PC to the store, or do you pick it up?
questions.answer: We serve customers in person in Bento Gonçalves, but we also pick up and deliver in nearby cities. For a quick fix, we can arrange pickup or you can bring it straight to the workshop.

questions.question: How does support work after delivery?
questions.answer: Lifetime after-sales support: a question, a strange noise, or a future upgrade, you message us on WhatsApp and get help from whoever built your PC, not a call-center script.
